findings.detail: Build Archery Range: wood: only 61 available for 175 (command probably had no effect)

findings.detail: Queue Archer: wood: no drop of ~25 on screen
findings.explanation: Matcher artifact: 4 archers queued across two ranges within 1.5 s (14:13.430-14:14.924). On screen wood/gold go 730/180 -> 705/135 -> 680/103 -> 653/13: the last frame holds two archers (-50 wood, -90 gold) plus a lumberjack drop-off (+23 wood, so wood only -27). The greedy matcher pairs one archer with each drop, leaving this archer's wood and 45 gold over (ROADMAP: bursts of identical spends).

findings.detail: -45 not explained by a replay event
